name: Micro Finance (GBCDC)
benefit:
1. The maximum loan limit under this scheme is up to ₹1,25,000/-.
1. The interest rate in these schemes is 5 percent per annum.
1. In these schemes, 90 per cent of the unit cost will be provided as a loan, with 90 per cent from the national corporation, 5 per cent from the state government, and 5 per cent from the beneficiary contribution.
1. This loan is to be repaid in 48 equal monthly instalmen
_eligibility_text: 1. The applicant should belong to a socially and educationally backwards class. 1. The total annual income of the applicant's family should not exceed ₹3,00,000/-. 1. The applicant's age should be between 21 and 45 years as on the date of application. 1. The applicant must have experience in a business requiring technical and other skills.
